color-system.twistDescription: Maximum darkness — pure black #000000 pageBackground. Matrix green #00ff41 primary. Dark green #008f11 body text. Surface #0d1a0d deep forest-black. All borders rgba(0,255,65,0.4). Cyan #00e5ff for glitch channel split. CTA buttons: solid green bg / black text (reverse video).

type-system.twistDescription: Full matrix terminal typography. Share Tech Mono 400 (primary, retro CRT terminal) for h1/h2/h3/labels. Space Mono 400 for body/h4. All monospace, weight 400 only. h1 clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem). All headings #00ff41. Body #008f11. Labels 0.6875rem uppercase 0.15em tracking.

motion-system.twistDescription: Matrix rain cascade, glitch-shift, rgb-split (green/cyan), flicker, data-reveal, green-pulse, scanline. All timings 0.05–0.15s. Primary easing: step-start — binary switching. No organic curves.

grid-system.twistDescription: 1200px max-width. 16px gutter. 20px container padding. Patterns: matrix-full, matrix-main, matrix-sidebar, matrix-split, feature-grid (3-col), panel. All borders rgba(0,255,65,0.4). border-radius 0 everywhere.

spacing-system.twistDescription: 8px base grid. Section padding 48px. Card 20px. Nav 20px inline. Grid gap 16px. Terminal density balanced for long-form reading.

interaction-states.twistDescription: 0.05s step-start all transitions. Primary: reverse video on hover. Ghost: trace green bg + glow. Links: glow on hover. Cards: border to full brightness (no box-shadow). Focus: dashed green outline. All border-radius 0.

nav-system.twistDescription: 48px fixed. Share Tech Mono 0.6875rem uppercase 0.15em tracking. [BRAND] bracket logo. Green bottom border 0.3→0.8 on scroll. Link hover: text-shadow glow. 0.05s step-start. Pure black scrolled bg. No backdrop blur.

concept-summary.twistDescription: CRT phosphor terminal aesthetic — pure black ground, matrix green #00ff41 as the only hue. Digital rain as hero background. Scramble text on load. Hex step numbering. System log testimonials with timestamps. All typography monospaced. Component vocabulary: terminal panels with green borders, no radius, no shadow.

A_colorContrast.notes: headingText #00ff41 (high luminance green) vs pageBackground #000000 (pure black) — maximum contrast. bodyText #008f11 vs #000000 — readable dark green on pure black. navText #008f11 → #00ff41 on scroll — both readable against transparent/black background.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Motion base 0.05–0.15s. Interaction transitions 0.05s. All use step-start — mechanically unified binary-switch aesthetic. No timing mismatch.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: Nav typography fontFamily 'Share Tech Mono', monospace. Share Tech Mono is the primary font in assembled type system (ds-font-family-primary). Full availability confirmed via Google Fonts CDN.
